author: Sumit Kumar
description: Select text in another app and press your shortcut. Ledge uses Apple Translation on this Mac and shows Copy and safe Replace in a floating card. Choose a target language and a second language for text already in it. An optional button beside mouse selections is off by default. Requires Accessibility, macOS 15 and LedgeKit API 0.24.0; Beta 10 is too old. Language files may need downloading. No text is sent to this add-on or an online service.
name: Quick Translate
summary: Translate selected text in a card beside it
